messages.name: bootstrap
messages.semantics: Actual approved document row; request1 and offer1; width640/height480/stride2560. No editor work before owned process/channel installed.

messages.name: deliver_input
messages.semantics: One genuine Focus event, no FDs. offer_id must be zero. Flags exactly 0 NORMAL, 1 RESET, 2 SAVE_CAPTURE. Child applies locally and acknowledges before the next event. SAVE_CAPTURE freezes state and permits only the immediately following matching RequestPublication, under the original Ctrl+S deadline.

messages.name: input_ack
messages.semantics: Successful exact pending input acknowledgment has flags 0 UNCHANGED or 1 APPLIED_UNPUBLISHED. text_generation and view_generation each remain equal or increase by exactly one from the previous acknowledgment; text change requires view increase. No successful acknowledgment alone updates parent display or mints Save. Save capture acknowledgment requires an immediate publication request. Errors have only request_id/status nonzero and no FDs.

messages.name: stop
messages.semantics: reason1 close,2 revoke,3 expiry,4 fault,5 transport-invalid,6 deadline. Notification cannot replace actual wait/reap.

messages.name: publish
messages.semantics: Returns the exact pending Bootstrap or RequestPublication offered pair. input_sequence is the last actually acknowledged input, or zero for bootstrap; generations exactly match the latest accepted input acknowledgment. No later input may be delivered until publication terminal handling. Parent validates actual immutable state, not semantic edits inferred from generation claims.

messages.name: publish_ack
messages.semantics: Ok consumes genuinepending pair once; deniedreply zeroexceptrequest/status. ACK is not proof child closed every read alias.

messages.name: receipt_notice
messages.semantics: Informational own original outcome after parentfull176receiptvalidation. outcome0 committed/1 definitive-noncommit; phase0 Saved-current/1 Saved-older-current-unsaved/2 definitive-noncommit. NoUnknownpretendreceipt. Parent retains genuine committedhash privately; child changes base revision onlyoncommittednotice forowncapture. No ordinarygrantrevival.

messages.name: request_publication
messages.semantics: Parent-only flush bound to the latest genuine acknowledgment and fresh offered pair. flags exactly0 NORMAL or2 SAVE_CAPTURE. Flush at128 acknowledged deliveries OR64 key-down events including modifiers, whichever first, before any next input; releases count only toward delivery cap. Genuine Ctrl+S forces immediate capture flush under the original Instant/deadline; no later input until terminal handling.

wire.generation_rules: Bootstrap generations are one. Per genuine child-local event, acknowledgment generations remain equal or advance by checked one according to body/view changes. Publication generations equal the latest acknowledged pair. Batch publication threshold is128 acknowledged deliveries OR64 key-down events including modifiers, whichever first; it does not count only changed/applied inputs. Acknowledgments alone grant no Save/render authority; counters do not wrap.
wire.no_new_grants: existing permissions63 and endpoint classes remain; process endpoint isopaque attached carrier only

publication_policy.ctrl_s: Immediate matching flush after all preceding input acknowledgments, under original captured 1000 ms deadline. No later input until capture acceptance or terminal failure.
publication_policy.4096_ascii_case: Genuine selected empty artifact.4096 unmodified ASCII a presses and4096 releases produce8192 DeliverInput and8192 InputAck records.64 edit publications plus bootstrap and one immediate genuine Ctrl+S publication =66 pairs for edit+Save. One optional final state/chrome close-boundary publication may bring whole scenario to67, still below128. Ctrl down/S down triggers genuine capture; S up/Ctrl up are retained after terminal capture and do not mint another intent. No initial deletion/chords are omitted.
publication_policy.publication_budget_exhaustion: Retire truthfully with prior accepted state and original Save ownership retained; no silent refund. Interactive frame flushes consume real lifetime credits.
publication_policy.batch_counter_rule: Increment delivery count for every genuine acknowledged press/release/reset event. Increment key-down count for each actual key-down, including modifiers, whether text changes or not. Force flush when either reaches its cap, before the next event. Release events do not increment key-down count. Counters reset only after a terminal accepted publication, never refund lifetime offers.

transitions: Ready → AwaitingInputAck only for a genuine parent Focus dequeue. No offered FDs or parent editing.
AwaitingInputAck → Ready only for the exact terminal child acknowledgment; retain unflushed generations and delivery and key-down counts. Errors cannot mint a Save intent.

Ready → AwaitingPublication only for Bootstrap or parent RequestPublication bound to the latest acknowledgment and exact offered pair; force at128 acknowledged deliveries OR64 key-downs including modifiers, whichever first and immediately for genuine Ctrl+S.
AwaitingPublication → Ready only after terminal publication handling; valid sealed pair replaces current state, denial preserves prior pair, protocol fault retires the channel.
process_state_machine.independent_save_state: Common parent app SaveChains retains existing original Allocate/Commit/Unknown/reconcile/source/IO owners across child death. Child reap never proves Store writer join.

authority.process_wait_ownership: ProcessSupervisor alone owns OwnedLinuxProcess fork-derived PID/birth/pidfd and waitpid. OwnedEditorChild owns opaque supervised record/channel/JoinHandle. Retire requests signal; join validates authentic terminal result then joins supervisor. Error returns sole owner and charges.
authority.opaque_observation: Public getter-only process/exit observations describe actual held owners; private fields/no constructors, never authority. No raw FD getter.
authority.enrollment: Genuine initialized NativeEditor consumed once; shared process-mode tag denies legacy step/render and repeat Read/take_editor; preparation failure returns unchanged editor.
authority.public_signature_inventory: docs/DESKTOP_EDITOR_PROCESS_API_V0.md after Root adoption; exact private candidate api-signatures.rs.txt.

process.wait_owner: Only ProcessSupervisor owns internal OwnedLinuxProcess fork-derived PID, pidfd and waitpid authority. OwnedEditorChild owns opaque supervised record, channel and supervisor JoinHandle. Retire requests signal; consuming join validates authentic terminal result then joins supervisor. Uncertainty returns owner and all charges.

transport.charges: Reserve before each actual create, dup, ancillary import or mmap. Every live parent-owned FD alias and data mapping counts individually. Transfer changes the authentic owner, never fabricates a release. Fixed-process and data ledgers are separate; combined cap is28 per child. Ambient host descriptors and fork-child aliases are outside this finite parent ledger claim.

recording_proposed.binary_retention_scope: Separately charged from2GiB raw/control/metadata corpus. Exact registered child-feature-only Cargo artifact and held executable snapshot pin, at most1GiB per retained binary; no arbitrary artifact path opens.
recording_proposed.control_storage: One compact append-only controls JSONL leaf per scenario, no sampling or implicit segmentation. Every actual delivery, acknowledgment and control event has monotonic row index, direction, request/sequence, canonical bytes, credentials and FD-ledger references. Count and byte caps both enforce before append.
recording_proposed.raw_leaf_class: Raster/text/raw receipt leaves remain at most2MiB. Only controls JSONL has explicit16MiB leaf class. Metadata leaves at most32MiB. All retained raw/control/metadata files charge the2GiB corpus and16384 files/17000 entries caps; separately retained child binaries charge their explicit1GiB-per-binary budget.
recording_proposed.raw_ref_join: Each scenario has exactly one complete controls JSONL leaf reference, not one raw leaf per event. Scenario metadata binds leaf size/hash/row count and monotonic row range; rows reference actual immutable FD/object ledger rows and separate raw text/raster/receipt leaves. raw_refs_per_scenario1024 bounds these file references; controls32768 bounds rows independently. No row is dropped, sampled or borrowed.

controls_row_layout.encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON object + LF; unique keys; canonical field order i,k,d,b,c,o,q,s,t,f,r; at most512 bytes including LF.

fields.d: u8 direction0 parent-to-child,1 child-to-parent,2 denied helper probe
fields.b: base64 of exact attempted or actual88 control bytes; exactly120 ASCII characters for a complete frame; malformed short/long control bytes use a separately bound raw leaf reference in r instead
fields.c: [u32 actual PID,u32 actual UID,u32 actual GID], or null for parent send without received credentials; credential provenance is explicit in k/d and actual process ledger
fields.o: array of0..3 u32 authentic object/FD-ledger references, not raw FD authority
fields.q: u64 request ID decoded from actual record,0 if malformed
fields.s: u64 actual input/publication sequence decoded or0 if malformed
fields.t: u64 actual monotonic timestamp offset from case start
fields.r: bounded actual outcome enum or raw-leaf index, never sampled bytes

controls_row_layout.counting: Exactly one canonical row per actual message transmission or denied send attempt, not duplicate sender+receiver rows. Parent outbound records actual send result; incoming records actual recv result/credentials; corresponding actual child acknowledgment binds input delivery. Further syscall/FD lifecycle evidence is retained in separate bounded actual ledgers, not silently discarded.

bounds.feasibility: Data peak10 plus bootstrap selected FD/map2 gives12; fixed FD inventory sums16, combined cap28 per child/56 for two. Lifetime257 objects and157831232 data bytes per child unchanged.4096 ASCII press/release requires8192 input deliveries plus8192 acknowledgments.128-delivery OR64-key-down threshold yields64 edit publications; bootstrap+CtrlS capture gives66, with at mostone final close-boundary publication gives67. Complete controls fit32768 rows/scenario and16MiB with512-byte maximum row. Every raw/control/metadata leaf also charges2GiB corpus cap.

fixed_process_FD_inventory.scope: Conservative simultaneous parent-owner cap, not fabricated occupancy. Source closes after verified copy. Parent-held sealed executable remains through actual reap. Transferred supervisor pidfd remains charged. Exact created aliases, closure and transfer times are retained.

executable.source_open: Only Root-registered artifact, O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, regular ELF source; exact registered build digest.
executable.held_copy: MFD_ALLOW_SEALING|MFD_CLOEXEC; bounded copy, held-byte digest, ELF validation, fchmod0500, WRITE|GROW|SHRINK|SEAL.
executable.execution: fork plus execveat(same held sealed FD, empty path, prepared argv/envp, AT_EMPTY_PATH). No path fallback, scripts or shell.
executable.parent_retention: Held sealed executable until genuine supervisor wait result and join; source FD closes after copy.
executable.system_dependencies: Dynamic loader/library dependencies are explicit host prerequisites; no whole-runtime containment claim.
